study: Stage B: shared multi-graph continuation (M) vs ordinary continuation (C); B1 focused pilot + B2 same-M graph matrix (spec 2026-10-01 rev. 2)

stageA_audit.Q1_41_of_48: RoboTwin admits a seed only after its scripted expert solves it (cuRobo planning, not deterministic). Admission per run varied: handover_mic 9/14 seeds admitted by all 30 runs, lift_pot 11/13, place_container_plate 9/13, open_microwave 0/22 (seeds admitted by 1-29 of 30 runs). 'Common' in the Stage-A table pooled the two replicates per arm (12+11+11+7=41). Admission is policy-independent (the expert runs before the policy), so no bias, but pairing and coverage suffered.
stageA_audit.Q2_G0_repeat_disagreement: Stage-A G0 replicates 0 and 1 used DIFFERENT actor-noise keys, and RoboTwin's instruction generator uses unseeded Python random (so the instruction text for a seed also varied between runs). The 38% disagreement = actor noise + instruction variation + simulator non-determinism. Separately, an identical-key pilot (same config, seed, noise; lift_pot) flipped 1 of 4 outcomes: simulator/controller stepping alone is non-deterministic.
stageA_audit.Q3_denominators_windows: task-macro: replicates averaged within a scene, scenes within task, tasks equal (common-scene denominators 12/11/7/11). Windows by exact solver index: early k=0-4, middle k=2-6, late k=5-9 (K=10, t_k=k/10); verified by execution traces (tests/test_rt_graph.py).
stageA_audit.Q4_action_differences: the reported action changes (early/middle <=0.024 rad, late 0.07-0.78 rad) were measured OFFLINE at matched observations and identical FM noise, not on diverged physical trajectories.
stageA_audit.operator: whole-block normalized residual h <- h + 0.5*(B(h) - h), twice (horsea/rt/graph.py _visit); NOT branch-wise halving. Frozen for Stage B.

fixes_for_stage_B: fixed prevalidated scene lists (expert run once per seed, instruction drawn once from RoboTwin's unseen set and stored); every arm evaluates exactly the listed scenes in order (policy/HorseaFM/fixed_scenes.py) -> identical scenes and instructions across arms
actor noise keyed by (eval seed 13, task, env seed, decision, replicate)
global simulator budget: at most 4 concurrent simulator processes (GPU memory)

scene_pools.D: first 20 expert-admitted seeds per task from 1,400,000; B2 uses the predeclared subset = the first 12 listed scenes
scene_pools.T: first 50 expert-admitted seeds per task from 1,500,000 -- prevalidated (expert only), UNOPENED

training.M: one graph per minibatch: P(G0)=1/2, P(each of 12 loops)=1/24 (own random stream)
training.common: from step-300k (sha256 prefix 4f9e60aff6719bc5); 5,000 updates; AdamW betas 0.95/0.999 eps 1e-8 wd 1e-6; lr 1e-5 (0.1x base peak); 250 warm-up then constant; batch 64; clip 100; 50-task data demos 0-44; original augmentation; decoder dropout as original; frozen: vision/language/state/camera embedding/DiT obs encoder; trainable: decoder blocks, ac_proj, dec_pos, time_net (not w), eps_out; paired streams (order, augmentation, FM noise/time) keyed by (seed, update)

B2.configs: the 11 other loop graphs + M_K11 + M_K12 (M_G0 and M_b0_middle reused from B1 on the same 12 scenes)
outputs: block x window table vs M_G0
rankings across scene-grouped folds and replicates

integrity_diagnostic.M_G0_dup: M u5000, G0, replicate 0, repeated on the 12-scene subset with the identical noise key: measures simulator non-determinism (48 episodes)
